cases.name: module-inventory/field-notes
args: import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import{readFileSync}from'node:fs';import{createHash}from'node:crypto';import{moduleInventory}from'@lapxo/bound/closure/native';const digest=b=>'sha256:'+createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex'),limits={members:20,bytes:100000,responseBytes:200000},context={scope:'consumer/modules',by:'consumer',at:'policy:module-inventory'},fixture=JSON.parse(readFileSync('samples/module-inventory/yes.json','utf8')).find(one=>one.name==='field-notes'),negative=JSON.parse(readFileSync('samples/no/module-inventory/no.json','utf8')).find(one=>one.name==='field-notes'),yes=new TextEncoder().encode(fixture.carrier),inventory=moduleInventory(yes,fixture.pin,limits,fixture.sources,context);assert.equal(inventory.lines,fixture.expected);assert.equal(inventory.modules.length,2);assert.ok(!inventory.modules.some(one=>one.module==='unreached.js'));assert.equal(moduleInventory(yes,fixture.pin,limits,fixture.sources,context).lines,fixture.expected);const bad=new TextEncoder().encode(negative.carrier);assert.throws(()=>moduleInventory(bad,digest(bad),limits,fixture.sources,context),/REFUSE·closure delivery/);assert.throws(()=>moduleInventory(bad,fixture.pin,limits,fixture.sources,context),/bundle bytes differ/);assert.throws(()=>moduleInventory(yes,fixture.pin,limits,[],context),/source coverage/);console.log('INVENTORY field-notes · 2 modules · exact canonical lines · integrity and coverage refused');

matches.pattern: INVENTORY field-notes · 2 modules · exact canonical lines · integrity and coverage refused
